title: Public Education Institutions by District
description: Number of primary, secondary, and tertiary public education institutions at national, state, and district level.

fields.name: date
fields.title: Date
fields.description: [Date] Date in YYYY-MM-DD format, with MM-DD set to 01-01 as the data is at annual frequency

fields.name: state
fields.title: State
fields.description: [Categorical] One of 16 states, or Malaysia for national-level data

fields.name: district
fields.title: District
fields.description: [Categorical] One of 160 administrative districts, or 'All Districts' for state-level data

fields.name: stage
fields.title: Education Stage
fields.description: [Categorical] Either primary, secondary, or tertiary education

fields.name: type
fields.title: School Type
fields.description: [Categorical] Type of public school or institution

methodology: This dataset is tabulated from school-level administrative records maintained by the Ministry of Education Malaysia via the Education Management Information System (EMIS).
